definition: 100 * (Triton_ms - candidate_ms) / Triton_ms. Positive saves time, negative is slower. Geomean uses timing ratios, never arithmetic means of percentages.

Mixed mode rank0 only: distinct emitted training kernel names, resolving eligible names using recorded selected backends. Unknown/unexecuted/conflicting selections stay in kernel_selection_unknown. These are static kernel counts, not invocation counts or GPU time shares. ATen, eager, GEMM/conv and RCCL excluded.

Identical model set with all three backends validated, stable, metadata and compiler sources matching in BOTH tuning modes. Training-only, warnings, unstable, failed or incomparable rows remain visible separately.
Pointwise/SIMD search modes0/1. GEMM and conv stay ATen in every mode. Mixed means per-kernel FlyDSL/Triton selection; pure FlyDSL has selection disabled, with unsupported-kernel fallback retained.

Full randomly initialized architectures, original global batch, actual forward/backward/SGD, no checkpoints/offload. Pure FlyDSL is measured in a separate sequential pass; measurement timestamps and source paths are included. Large-model FSDP results are separated by GPU count and validation tier.
At least four repeats; spread<=20%, downward trend<=10%, no timing recompiles. Within3percent is a reporting band, not a confidence interval.
Missing timings and ratios are blank, never zero. Access, capacity, OOM and compiler errors remain explicit. No extrapolation or fabricated result.
